text:
Alex: Heads-up — during the compacting run in eu-west1c we saw a cluster of warm-pool pinned slots that weren't reclaimed, causing small-pod fragmentation and a spike in pending tiny-gang jobs. Also noticed egress tx drops around the same time.
Priya: Same, noticed + eviction churn. window ~03:10-03:40 UTC. pods kept getting requeued instead of being packed. :eyes:
Ravi: Probable root: latebind ordering + pinned-slot guards + netheal delays. oncall dump shows repeated lease handshakes failing, then taint-evictions.
Marta: ops-bot reported node flaps on rack-4 at 03:12 UTC (netlink up/down). See bot entry below.
ops-bot: node/node-az4 netlink: link-state flapping detected (count=6) — attached to ticket INC-2025.
Priya: paste of the core logs: 
```
LeaseHandler: handshake timeout=120s pod=kube-gang-45
NodeWatcher: mark PENDING -> UNSCHED due to taint gpu-isolated=true
Scheduler: defer bind because warmpool.locked=true
NetworkAgent: qdisc tx errors=37 if=eth0
```
Alex: That lease timeout + warmpool.locked combo looks like the scheduler is refusing to preempt pinned slots while the node is limping, so pods stay pending and create fragmentation.
Ravi: Also saw egress shaping on that rack — traffic policing caused the kubelet heartbeats to queue, lengthening the lease handshake. Netheal retries = 5 in ~2m.
Sam: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) increase lease handshake to 180s? 2) add an emergency override to allow warmpool-protected slots to be reclaimed if network health is degraded for >30s. 3) temporarily lift egress shaping on the rack.
Priya: Option 2 sounds safest for correctness; option 3 costs ops time and maybe bill, but reduces churn.
Marta: Ops can temporarily bump egress qdisc to remove policing on rack-4; I'll schedule a low-risk window in 10m if y'all agree.
Alex: We should avoid long-term increasing handshake timeout — that hides real flaps. Prefer a reclaim override and a scheduler tweak to prefer compacting when warmpool_protected_age > 15m.
Ravi: I'll open the scheduler PR for the override + a small metric to track warmpool-reclaims/evictions to ensure we don't regress. linking draft: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/402 (WIP).
Sam: I can prototype the reclaim rule and run it in canary eu-west1c. If it stabilizes, we can roll to other regions.
Priya: Ops change completed: `tc qdisc change dev eth0 root handle 1: pfifo limit 10000` on rack-4 — removing policing for 5m now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary patch to scheduler-gamma to eu-west1c started (canary=3 nodes) — track metrics in /dashboards/pack-compact.
Alex: Action items: create INC-2025 (Marta), PR for reclaim override (Ravi), canary patch (Sam), monitor cost impact of temporarily removing egress shaping (Priya). If canary shows reduced pending-surge and fragmentation rate drops, we pick patch for next stable rollout. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll tag you all on the PR when it's ready and post a short runbook for the reclaim override behavior.
Priya: noted — will capture tokenized cost delta for the 5m unshaped window.
Marta: assigning INC-2025 to ops, adding timeline + rollback steps. ping me for hands-on. :wave:
Alex: Thanks — will keep an eye on compact metrics. update here in 15m.
